notes:
- Distortion & Clipper: "Match Loudness" now moves the real Output dial as you drive harder, so perceived level stays steady; warmer, cleaner analog-style saturation with a DC blocker. Clipper Ceiling↔Output link is on by default.
- Delay: louder and more Ableton-like — full-level first repeat and an equal-power dry/wet mix so the dry signal doesn't dip below 50% mix.
- Multiband Exciter: click anywhere in a band to bypass its saturation (band still passes); cleaner high-band tone and stronger, more usable drive range.
- Auto Filter: resonance now bottoms out at a true zero (no resonance) and defaults there.
- New: "Install DT Effects…" in the settings menu downloads and installs the full DuckTape effect set as DAW plug-ins (VST3, plus AU on macOS) — per-user, no admin.
- Factory presets added across the stock effects.
